tasks.title: Freeze scope and evidence vocabulary
tasks.implementation: Record SIM, USB BENCH and gated extensions in docs/decisions.md.
tasks.acceptance: Every capability has implemented/mocked/blocked status; no implied certification.

tasks.title: Create reproducible repository
tasks.implementation: Create core, board adapters, contracts, apps, backend, tests and evidence folders; pin qualified tool versions.
tasks.acceptance: Clean checkout reproduces host tests and records actual compiler/core versions.

tasks.title: Define typed HAL ports
tasks.implementation: Define Clock, MotionSample, LocationFix, Journal, Audio, Ui and Transport without SDK types in the core.
tasks.acceptance: The same deterministic core runs under mock and board adapters.

tasks.title: Create requirement traceability
tasks.implementation: Map R01-R18 to tasks and tests; version BOM, pins, wires and protocol.
tasks.acceptance: Every electrical or payload change updates all affected artifacts.

tasks.title: Set CI and evidence rules
tasks.implementation: Run schemas, native compilation and contract tests; separate physical gates.
tasks.acceptance: CI cannot mark a mocked sensor or radio as physically passed.

tasks.title: Verify exact received parts
tasks.implementation: Match part revisions, headers, connectors, cable polarity and terminal assembly.
tasks.acceptance: No item requires user soldering; receiving photos and continuity results retained.

tasks.title: Assemble segregated power
tasks.implementation: Build USB board feeds and fused EXT_5V load distribution.
tasks.acceptance: No positive rail tie; measured idle/peak rails remain within selected ratings.

tasks.title: Wire main sensor bus
tasks.implementation: Connect A4/A5, main QT hub, BMP390 and MAX-M10S at3.3V.
tasks.acceptance: Only expected addresses; missing sensor does not hang startup.

tasks.title: Wire Nicla signal-only harness
tasks.implementation: Use4483, isolated5625 and4209; leave V+ insulated; add reviewed pull-ups.
tasks.acceptance: J5.1 not connected to Nano or sensor supply; logic levels physically checked.

tasks.title: Wire UI and level shifter
tasks.implementation: Build S1/S2, AHCT125, five logical pixels and Grove outputs.
tasks.acceptance: No5V input at Nano; unused AHCT pins defined; switch legs verified.

tasks.title: Approve electrical evidence
tasks.implementation: Record measured rails, load current, wiring photographs and reviewed net schedule.
tasks.acceptance: A second engineer signs off before integrated powered testing.

tasks.title: Qualify dual I2C setup
tasks.implementation: Nicla external controller to Nano target0x2A; independent Nano sensor controller.
tasks.acceptance: 10,000 frames with measured sequence/CRC results; core versions recorded.

tasks.title: Acquire and calibrate IMU
tasks.implementation: Read BMI270 with supported driver; request100Hz,+/-16g,+/-2000dps and read back settings.
tasks.acceptance: Units, axes, clipping, overrun and freshness are observable.

tasks.title: Implement binary frame codec
tasks.implementation: Explicitly encode/decode fixed32-byte frames and CRC.
tasks.acceptance: Golden fixtures and malformed frames tested; no struct-layout assumptions.

tasks.title: Implement control mailbox
tasks.implementation: Poll8-byte mailbox10Hz; execute privacy/health commands idempotently.
tasks.acceptance: Result frame confirms applied state; mute never silently disables motion.

tasks.title: Qualify custom wake model
tasks.implementation: Train/license Hello Svaraa model through supported tooling; record model hash.
tasks.acceptance: False/missed triggers tested in noise; model stub never labelled trained.

tasks.title: Implement pressure adapter
tasks.implementation: Read pressure/health with bounded timeout and baseline-aware relative altitude.
tasks.acceptance: Internal temperature not presented as body temperature; stale/fault marked.

tasks.title: Implement GNSS quality
tasks.implementation: Read0x42, valid fix, source, accuracy, timestamp and age.
tasks.acceptance: No-fix and indoor cases preserve null coordinates; no invented live position.

tasks.title: Implement custom tags
tasks.implementation: Store immutable tag with label, notes and location provenance; sync by ID.
tasks.acceptance: Offline tag persists once; phone fix explicitly labelled phone.

tasks.title: Implement later SOS location
tasks.implementation: SendSOS first; enrich same incident with a new event ID when fix arrives.
tasks.acceptance: No GPS wait in trigger path; late stale observation cannot replace newer fix.

tasks.title: Implement debounced manual hold
tasks.implementation: Nonblocking20ms debounce and proposed2s hold; boot-held input must release.
tasks.acceptance: One qualified hold creates one live incident; bounce cannot duplicate it.

tasks.title: Implement five-pixel states
tasks.implementation: Map index0 top,1-4 lower; force all remaining bench pixels off.
tasks.acceptance: Distinct pending/received/humanACK patterns; color not sole feedback.

tasks.title: Implement buzzer/haptic
tasks.implementation: Use onboard-driver modules with bounded duration/duty.
tasks.acceptance: Assistant audio failure does not remove independent local alarm.

tasks.title: Implement privacy request
tasks.implementation: Stop PCM/upload, request Nicla mute and display pending/applied state.
tasks.acceptance: Physical switch dominates remote unmute; no hard-isolation claim.

tasks.title: Review accessible gestures
tasks.implementation: Specify short prealert cancel, longSOS override and active cancellation request.
tasks.acceptance: No deletion of already-delivered incident; no voice-only critical action.

tasks.title: Qualify I2S timing
tasks.implementation: Shared BCLK/WS, separateRX/TX;16kHz stereo32-bit slots.
tasks.acceptance: Clock measurements and signed left-channel conversion correct.

tasks.title: Implement bounded PCM buffers
tasks.implementation: DMA rings and bounded upload/playback queues below safety priority.
tasks.acceptance: Stalled network cannot exhaust heap or blockSOS.

tasks.title: Implement half-duplex session
tasks.implementation: Explicit authorized voice session; local wake; Wi-Fi upload; turn timeout.
tasks.acceptance: No non-triggering background audio upload; privacy ends session.

tasks.title: Implement tool allowlist
tasks.implementation: Validate tag/status intents and authorization; isolate safety authority.
tasks.acceptance: LLM cannot suppressSOS, acknowledge as human or change ownership.

tasks.title: Stress audio and emergency path
tasks.implementation: Run audio, GNSS and radio while triggeringSOS and sensor faults.
tasks.acceptance: Measured latency and queue limits pass; reduce audio load if needed.

title: Safety reducer, journal and route policy

tasks.title: Implement deterministic reducer
tasks.implementation: Use reference core, immutable IDs, monotonic time and server revisions.
tasks.acceptance: Tests cover precedence, cancellation and non-regressing acknowledgment.

tasks.title: Implement experimental fall candidate
tasks.implementation: Version feature/model configuration and input quality gates.
tasks.acceptance: Synthetic positives/negatives pass without a clinical accuracy claim.

tasks.title: Implement bounded durable journal
tasks.implementation: Append/CRC/commit/replay; reserve critical capacity; do not persist raw100Hz forever.
tasks.acceptance: Power-cut replay preserves committed events; write failure remains visible.

tasks.title: Implement retry and routing
tasks.implementation: Reuse original event bytes/ID across available routes and bounded jittered retry.
tasks.acceptance: Lost receipt and dual-route delivery create one backend incident.

tasks.title: Isolate drills and live events
tasks.implementation: Server-issued drill ID and test-only recipients; real physicalSOS preempts.
tasks.acceptance: New live incident ID on preemption; no drill into live provider.

tasks.title: Implement health/watchdog
tasks.implementation: Track source/task/storage/link freshness and reboot cause independently.
tasks.acceptance: Stalled required task is not hidden by unconditional watchdog feed.

tasks.title: Implement GATT/fragments
tasks.implementation: Versioned service, MTU-aware fragments,2048-byte bound and timeout.
tasks.acceptance: MTU23 and malformed sequences tested; no unbounded allocation.

tasks.title: Implement ownership proof
tasks.implementation: Reviewed physical-presence/OOB enrollment; scoped credentials and revocation.
tasks.acceptance: Device ID or Just Works alone cannot grant ownership.

tasks.title: Implement phone relay queue
tasks.implementation: Persist original device event; relay under assigned-device authority.
tasks.acceptance: Gateway cannot impersonate another device or rewrite event identity.

tasks.title: Authenticate return path
tasks.implementation: Return verified backend receipts/commands and explicit executionACK.
tasks.acceptance: ATT acknowledgment never becomes caregiver acknowledgment.

tasks.title: Test real phone lifecycle
tasks.implementation: Native iOS restoration/Android supported background design on physical phones.
tasks.acceptance: Termination, reboot and revoked permissions show degraded status honestly.

tasks.title: Implement contract validation
tasks.implementation: Typed models plus size, semantic, mode and authorization checks.
tasks.acceptance: Invalid/wrong-tenant events fail without actionable side effects.

tasks.title: Implement event transaction
tasks.implementation: Unique device/event, canonical hash, incident update and outbox in one commit.
tasks.acceptance: Identical duplicate returns receipt; changed duplicate409; race-safe.

tasks.title: Implement human actions
tasks.implementation: Assigned guardian permissions, unique actionID and expected revision.
tasks.acceptance: ConcurrentACK/resolve actions audited; no optimistic false success.

tasks.title: Implement notification worker
tasks.implementation: Configurable contact order and timers; mock adapter first.
tasks.acceptance: Provider submit/delivery/humanACK remain distinct; drill cannot dispatch.

tasks.title: Implement reconciliation
tasks.implementation: Current snapshot plus expiring command cursor and execution acknowledgment.
tasks.acceptance: Offline pendant converges; expired command does not execute later.

tasks.title: Implement consent and audit
tasks.implementation: Household roles, location retention/revocation and immutable action history.
tasks.acceptance: Cross-household access denied; sensitive debug logging controlled.

tasks.title: Build wearer dashboard
tasks.implementation: Routes, source freshness, actual battery source, privacy and current incident.
tasks.acceptance: Unknown/mocked values labelled; app-open does not imply hardware health.

tasks.title: Build guardian incident view
tasks.implementation: Trigger, time, fix source/age/accuracy and explicit acknowledgment.
tasks.acceptance: Received, humanACK and resolved distinguishable.

tasks.title: Build drill flow
tasks.implementation: Test input/feedback/guardian acknowledgment with persistentDRILL labels.
tasks.acceptance: RealSOS interrupts; unavailable component checks remain untested.

tasks.title: Build tags and history
tasks.implementation: Labels/categories with preserved coordinate provenance and sync state.
tasks.acceptance: No-fix tag allowed; optional geofence dwell/hysteresis tested.

tasks.title: Build recovery/accessibility
tasks.implementation: Large controls, non-color cues, permission/pairing reconnect recovery.
tasks.acceptance: Core tasks usable without voice; elderly-facing usability evidence retained.

tasks.title: Create Wokwi adapter
tasks.implementation: S3 button/pixels and typed mocks for unsupported hardware.
tasks.acceptance: Separate rawGPIO map; no claim BLE/I2S/Nicla target simulated.

tasks.title: Create deterministic traces
tasks.implementation: Timestamped synthetic/recorded motion, pressure and GPS with units/source.
tasks.acceptance: Repeatable outcomes; synthetic traces never labelled clinical validation.

tasks.title: Inject communication faults
tasks.implementation: No-route, lost response, duplicate, reorder, clock jump and reconnect fixtures.
tasks.acceptance: Idempotency and monotonic deadlines hold.

tasks.title: Build end-to-end drill test
tasks.implementation: Virtual device -> actual local backend -> bothUI roles -> return acknowledgment.
tasks.acceptance: Correlated event log and zero real emergency-provider calls.

tasks.title: Fuzz and stress resources
tasks.implementation: Malformed frames, queue full, low heap and slow audio consumer.
tasks.acceptance: Explicit bounded failures; no silent emergency state loss.

tasks.title: Build evidence report
tasks.implementation: Record profile, commit, versions, scenario, actual result and reviewer.
tasks.acceptance: Separate host/emulator/bench/field evidence; blockers visible.

tasks.title: Threat-model trust boundaries
tasks.implementation: SpoofedSOS, unauthorized location, malicious commands, stolen device and provisioning.
tasks.acceptance: Each risk has control, test and owner.

tasks.title: Provision development identity
tasks.implementation: Unique test credentials, validatedTLS and future rotation design.
tasks.acceptance: No shared fleet production secret or disabled certificate validation.

tasks.title: Design signed update recovery
tasks.implementation: Image compatibility/signature, deferredOTA during incident and rollback.
tasks.acceptance: Invalid/interrupted update cannot be accepted as successful.

tasks.title: Implement consent/retention
tasks.implementation: Location/audio purpose, role revocation, audit and deletion policy.
tasks.acceptance: No ambient audio upload; tests enforce access removal.

tasks.title: Run electrical/thermal matrix
tasks.implementation: Measure peak combined loads and instrumented signal timing.
tasks.acceptance: No unexplained rail, heat or reset issue; setup/limits recorded.

tasks.title: Run full communication fault matrix
tasks.implementation: Physical phones, network loss, staleGPS, duplicateSOS and missed response.
tasks.acceptance: Documented honest UI state in each failure; no false help confirmation.

tasks.title: Plan safe fall-data evaluation
tasks.implementation: Use fixtures/dummies and reviewed normal-activity protocol, not dangerous human falls.
tasks.acceptance: Report false/missed labelled events by context; avoid unsupported generalization.

tasks.title: Triage gates and defects
tasks.implementation: Classify bench/pilot/manufacturing blockers with named owner.
tasks.acceptance: Electrical, privacy or lostSOS issues are not cosmetic waivers.

tasks.title: Freeze V0 dossier
tasks.implementation: Versions, wiring, tests, limits and engineering sign-off.
tasks.acceptance: Release is bench demonstrator only, not a sole emergency lifeline.

tasks.title: Quote architecture options
tasks.implementation: Phone-assisted vs standalone dataSOS; measure before consolidating controllers.
tasks.acceptance: SeparateBOM, assembly,NRE/tooling and service assumptions.

tasks.title: Engineer product power
tasks.implementation: Select matched cell/NTC/protection/powerpath/gauge/coil/supervisor.
tasks.acceptance: Reviewed schematic, thermal/current/runtime tests; magnets not protocol proof.

tasks.title: Engineer RF and enclosure
tasks.implementation: Antenna/coil/metal keepouts, speaker/vent, bridge/flex and mechanical tests.
tasks.acceptance: Determine fixed bridge vs moving hinge; final on-body tests before tooling.

tasks.title: Qualify cellular/Find My
tasks.implementation: Actual carrier/data/voice choice and licensed MFi path with devkits.
tasks.acceptance: No invented proprietary protocol or automatic approval claim.

tasks.title: Define production test and release
tasks.implementation: NativeCAD, ERC/DRC,DFM/DFT, fixtures, unique identities,EVT/DVT/PVT and pilot evidence.
tasks.acceptance: A quotation is not validation; no10k release without gates.
